desc: Implement the iterative Segment Tree solution:
Define the `Node` structure (or tuple) storing `(count, next_start_index)`.
Calculate lengths of the two ranges.
Binary search for the maximum $k$ such that $A[\text{left.start} + i] \times 2 \le A[\text{right.end} - i]$ for all $0 \le i < k$.
Process queries by collecting $O(\log N)$ nodes and merging them sequentially.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Check for potential index out of bounds errors in the binary search logic.
